## Implementation evidence (commit 5a755e189a0, Gerrit change 3205)

- RED: with only the test changes, `test_make_test_runs_exactly_the_gating_cells_pytest_selections` failed ("Right contains one more item: ('integration', 'loadgroup')") and `test_make_test_selection_is_a_superset_of_every_matrix_cell` failed with integration=True gaps for all 4 cells. The negative fixture test and the refactored primary-cell test passed.
- GREEN: after the Makefile change, `pytest tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py` = 38 passed. `make -n test` prints both invocations: `pytest -m "not integration and not external" -n 4 --dist worksteal -q` then `pytest -m integration -n 4 --dist loadgroup --max-worker-restart=0 -q`.
- AC5 demonstration: added a temporary `tests/unit/` module doing `git init --bare X` then `git -C X log` (the 7a7a shape), ran the Makefile's integration-tier command verbatim: rc=1, `FAILED tests/integration/test_bare_repository_fixture_portability.py::test_no_test_addresses_a_bare_repository_by_discovery`, 1 failed / 195 passed / 4 skipped, 239 s wall. Temporary module deleted; `git status` clean apart from the 4 intended files.
- `make lint` rc=0; `make typecheck` rc=0 (746 source files). 41 test modules that read AGENTS.md / docs/local-dev-env.md / the Makefile: 717 passed.
- `make verify` was not run in this session per operator direction; Gerrit Verified is the full-suite check.
